title: Freezing Bubbles
description:
Freezing soap bubbles on a -28C morning in Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada. 
If you want to try it out yourself, you will need:


100 mL of warm water
17 mL of dish soap
17 mL of corn syrup
1 tbsp of sugar


Mix together until sugar has dissolved and you're good to go. You just need a cold, calm day.
